items.title: Blue-Green Deployment
items.description: Deep dive into Blue-Green Deployment — zero-downtime releases, instant rollback, Kubernetes implementation, database migration compatibility (expand-contract), CI/CD pipeline integration, and comparison with canary and rolling updates.

items.title: Kubernetes & Spring Boot 3.x — Zero-Downtime Graceful Shutdown
items.description: Comprehensive guide to eliminating transient 502 Bad Gateway and Connection Reset errors during rolling updates and HPA scale-in using Kubernetes Pod Termination Lifecycle, preStop hooks, and Spring Boot 3 graceful shutdown.

items.title: Schema Migrations
items.description: Managing database schema changes safely in production — Flyway, Liquibase, zero-downtime migration patterns, and rollback strategies.
